diagnosis: Softmax drops the reduced axis in both internal reductions when keep_dims=False. Broadcasting then aligns the reduced tensors with trailing dimensions instead of the requested axis. For square inputs this silently produces incorrect values; other shapes may fail broadcasting. Both reductions must retain the axis so subtraction and division preserve the input shape and normalize each requested slice. Keep the public keep_dims argument for compatibility; softmax's internal reductions always need singleton dimensions. Actual device evidence reports 4/4 differing elements for shape [2,2], dim=1, versus passing controls with 0/4 differences for dim=0 and 0/128 for the vector. These controls are consistent with broadcasting working incidentally for the leading axis in two dimensions and scalar reductions for vectors. Raw values were unavailable through the attempted raw evidence ID. Compilation and post-patch correctness have not been tested in this bounded interface.
